note: FR-SEC-03 safety net for credentials whose format is not in secret.json. Entropy alone cannot decide this: a SHA-256 digest, a UUID, and a minified bundle are all high-entropy and none of them is a secret. So a value only counts when a credential-naming field introduces it, and the thresholds below are tuned against attack-lab/datasets/high-entropy-secrets.json.

thresholds.note: Bits per character (Shannon). Hex tops out near 4.0 because it draws from 16 symbols, so it needs a lower bar than a base64-ish value drawing from 64.

fields.note: Field names that introduce a credential. Deliberately excludes hash, checksum, digest, sha, commit, etag, id, and uuid: those name high-entropy values that are not secrets, and including them is how an entropy rule starts reporting every build log.
